question: A person on anti-tubercular drugs complained of deafness and tinnitus in one ear. Drug implicated is?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Anti-tubercular drugs" -> "possible side effects" -> "ototoxicity" -> "deafness and tinnitus" -> "Streptomycin" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Anti-tubercular drugs" -> "Isoniazid" -> "neuropathy" -> "not typically associated with deafness" -> "unlikely" -> 70%
CHAIN: "Anti-tubercular drugs" -> "Ethambutol" -> "visual disturbances" -> "not associated with hearing loss" -> "unlikely" -> 75%
analysis: The core medical principle here is the identification of ototoxic side effects associated with anti-tubercular drugs. Among the options provided, Streptomycin is well-documented to cause ototoxicity, leading to symptoms such as deafness and tinnitus. Isoniazid is primarily associated with peripheral neuropathy, Ethambutol with visual disturbances, and Rifampicin with hepatotoxicity. Given the specific symptoms of deafness and tinnitus in one ear, the consensus strongly supports that Streptomycin is the drug implicated in this case. Therefore, the most likely correct option is Streptomycin.
